item.title: Send a friend to an alternate skating session
item.context_text: A skating rink has cancelled your chosen session. Your friend has rented skates and has a bus home at six.
item.objective_text: Choose an alternative with enough time to skate and return the equipment.
success_conditions: Choose an alternative with enough time to skate and return the equipment.

children.title: Read the new timetable
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: Saturday’s three o’clock session has been cancelled. Your ticket works at four or at half past five. Each session lasts one hour. Rental skates must be returned by six.

questions.prompt: Which session can finish before six?
questions.explanation: The four o’clock session ends at five, and the later one ends at half past six.

children.title: Hear the attendant’s instructions
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: If you change to four, register at the desk fifteen minutes before. You can keep your rental receipt. If you can’t come at either time, bring your unused ticket to the desk for a refund.

questions.prompt: When should a four o’clock skater register?
questions.explanation: Fifteen minutes before four is a quarter to four.

questions.prompt: What do people bring if they need a refund?
questions.explanation: The attendant asks for the unused ticket.

children.title: Confirm a replacement ticket
children.prompt_text: The attendant is waiting to hear which session you want.
children.instructions: Ask to transfer to four o’clock. Check that your current rental receipt can be used.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Could we change our tickets to the four o’clock session? We have already rented skates. Can we keep the same rental receipt for the new time?

children.title: Write the plan to your friend
children.prompt_text: Your friend has not yet heard about the cancellation.
children.instructions: Include the meeting deadline and why the four o’clock slot works. Give your friend time to return the skates before the bus.
children.goal: Choose an alternative with enough time to skate and return the equipment.
children.model_answer: The three o’clock slot was cancelled. Let’s meet at the rink desk at 3:45 and register for four. That session finishes at five, so we can return our rental skates before your six o’clock bus. Keep your rental receipt for the desk.
